definitions.explanation: The state of things as they actually exist.

examples.english: The gap between reality and ideals.

examples.japanese: {現実|げんじつ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧

{現実|げんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧しか⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Accepting reality is not easy, but there is no choice but to move forward.

notes:
{現実|げんじつ} means reality or actuality — the way things truly are, as opposed to hopes, ideals, or imagination.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {現実|げんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept reality
- {現実|げんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to face reality
- {現実|げんじつ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧(な): realistic, practical
- {現実|げんじつ}⟦{離|ばな}れ→離れ：10003_banare⟧: being out of touch with reality
- {現実|げんじつ}⟦{逃避|とうひ}→逃避：14419_touhi⟧: escapism (fleeing from reality)
- {現実|げんじつ}{味|み}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to seem realistic/plausible

COMMON PATTERNS:
{現実|げんじつ} can function as a noun or as a no-adjective ({現実|げんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: a real problem). Adding ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ creates a na-adjective meaning 'realistic.'

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現実|げんじつ} vs ⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧: reality vs ideals
- {現実|げんじつ} vs ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧: reality vs dreams
- {現実|げんじつ} vs ⟦{虚構|きょこう}→虚構：09808_kyokou⟧: reality vs fiction
